description:
THIS IS A REQUEST FOR INFORMATION (RFI) ONLY. This RFI is issued solely for information and market research planning purposes for the DHS OCIO Network Cyber and Cloud Support (NCCS) Services 2.0.  

This RFI shall not be construed as an obligation on the part of the Government. This is NOT a Request for Quotations or Proposals. No solicitation document exists, and the Government may or may not issue a formal solicitation as a result of the responses received to this RFI.

All Responses shall be submitted to the Office of Procurement Operations (OPO) Industry Liaison mailbox at the following email address: opoindustryliaison@hq.dhs.gov no later than 12:00p.m. Eastern Time, Friday March 6, 2026.

Please see the full RFI and DRAFT SOW for more information.
